The '''Nightsister vs. Singing Mountain Clan Battle''' took place on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in the context of the prolonged conflict between the [[Singing Mountain Clan]] and the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]]. The battle involved [[Witches of Dathomir|witches]] armed with [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapons]], spell casters and [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]] on both sides.<ref name="SWG:NvSMCB" />
{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Nightsister vs. Singing Mountain Clan Battle appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:NvSMCB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
